title: RustIpfsStore: expose ipfs handle for IPNS publisher
description: Add pub(crate) fn ipfs_handle(&self) -> rust_ipfs::Ipfs method to RustIpfsStore in pipeline.rs. rust_ipfs::Ipfs is Arc-backed and Clone. Change the internal ipfs field to be accessible for cloning. In main.rs, extract the ipfs handle before boxing into Arc<dyn IpfsStore>: let rust_store = RustIpfsStore::new().await?; let ipfs_for_ipns = rust_store.ipfs_handle(); let ipfs_store = Arc::new(rust_store). Why: IpnsPublisher needs direct access to rust_ipfs::Ipfs to call publish_ipns().
